author: MrTiddlesworth
quote:
Oh my goodness, for the love of King Henry's bird!   What a load of boring old twaddle.  Unbelievably boring and repetitive campaign AND PvP multiplayer. Ridiculously long load times, 30 fps sluggish controls, unimaginative player v player mp (domination and death match! really that's it???), boring **** and did i forget to mention it's friggin boring.  I'd prefer to go shopping with my wife and listen to her waffle on about Kim Kardashian's **** for an afternoon.

Do not buy this over-hyped bloated mess, no I'm not talking about my wife still.

Where's the gun customisation?
Why do the controls feel like they are constantly angry at you and insist on fighting against your every command?
Where's the reason to even play this?
Why did idiots pre-order this?
Why is it a multiplayer game and there isn't really any decent multiplayer?
Why am I sat in loading screens more than in the game? Doesn't the PS4 have 8 gig of RAM?

Waste of time and space, no pun intended.

Got to go, I'm off shopping with the wife.
